patches.title: Battlefield 3 · Single-player compatibility
patches.description: Battlefield 3 only. Disables optional pbcl/pbcl64 DLL loading for the existing single-player campaign. Does not replace EA/Steam authentication, unlock content, or provide multiplayer/offline emulation. Remove this profile before joining multiplayer servers that require PunkBuster.

patches.title: Ground Zeroes · Startup compatibility
patches.description: Launch profile for MgsGroundZeroes.exe only. Enables image-page registration and the Wine tick thunk. Requires an Aura runtime containing the matching Wine/FEX support. This is a runtime-dependent profile, not a standalone game DLL or an FPS optimization. Removing the profile disables it next launch.

patches.title: Mirror’s Edge (2008) · Time conversion startup fix
patches.description: Exact-version executable patch routing the failing time conversion to the existing MSVCR80 implementation. Requires the original 60,167,392-byte EXE with SHA-256 84eea8fd3c4494d8ce3db8fc55b846f731425d6a2cd63da1189d641daf2929e4. Restore any legacy Aura startup patch before installation. Original EXE backed up locally.

patches.title: South Park: The Fractured But Whole · Address space compatibility
patches.description: Exact-version virtual-address allocation patch for SouthPark_TFBW.exe (223,530,184 bytes). Reduces virtual pool reservations, not physical RAM usage. Does not support The Stick of Truth. Restore any legacy Aura low-address patch first. Original EXE backed up locally.

patches.title: Ground Zeroes · MGSVFix widescreen
patches.description: MGSVFix 0.0.3 by Lyall, with Ultimate ASI Loader. Installs beside MgsGroundZeroes.exe and adds a per-game winmm=n,b override. Fixes resolution, aspect ratio and HUD for the selected display ratio. Intro skipping and FPS unlocking default off in this package. Wine/ARM64EC phone behavior still requires testing.

patches.title: Mirror’s Edge · Widescreen repair tool
patches.description: Mirror’s Edge Tweaks 4.5.0-beta3 by softsoundd. Interactive Windows tool requiring .NET 10; downloading is not applying the widescreen fix. Follow README instructions to apply FOV/resolution changes. Aura only manages removal of this downloaded tool, not game changes made later by the tool. Original tool, matching source and license notices are included in the repository.

patches.title: Stardew Valley · Experimental FPS unlock (SMAPI)
patches.description: StardewFPS 1.0 by Lake1059. Requires a compatible SMAPI installation and launching StardewModdingAPI.exe; This ZIP contains only mod files. Aura builds with SMAPI dependency management can install the pinned loader and select its launch entry when you enable this mod; the fps console command is still manual. For game 1.6; Wine/ARM64EC compatibility is unverified. After loading a save, turn off in-game VSync and enter fps 120 in the SMAPI console. Main menu stays at 60 FPS; repeat each launch. WARNING: changes animation and enemy speed; the author advises against normal play. This is not a performance fix or a guarantee of 120 FPS. Restart without the mod to restore normal timing; back up saves before experimenting. See the repository guide.

patches.title: Crysis 2 (1.9, 32-bit) · Optional DX9 renderer
patches.description: Optional native -dx9 launch profile for the verified 40,670,208-byte Crysis2.exe (SHA-256 0079d15b5b85a1ec7e50bb5e59c14eb255ffc247f2ac87e67b65b402bc8a7d91). Requires Aura 0.1.122 / versionCode 123 or later. This build filters r_Driver out of user.cfg and system.cfg; the native argument uses a separate startup branch. No game files, resolution, movies or saves are changed. Install and enable manually, then fully restart the game. Disabling restores the original launch arguments. Unknown or changed EXEs are not forced to DX9. May change available DX11 visual features. Actual CryRenderD3D9.dll loading, startup progress and cropped-screen improvement on Android are not yet verified; this is not a confirmed fix for the startup hang.

patches.title: Mirror’s Edge · 19.5:9 widescreen (direct install)
patches.description: Applies the 19.5:9 aspect-ratio fix directly to the verified Engine.u resource (for example 1560×720). No Tweaks tool or .NET is required. Supports the listed Base/DLC compressed and decompressed baselines; other modified resources are rejected. Keeps the executable and its startup compatibility patch unchanged. Disable or uninstall to restore the original resource. Use 1560×720/fullscreen in game; other aspect ratios need another recipe. Does not add configurable FOV, HUD or pre-rendered video fixes. Phone gameplay verification is pending. Requires the next Aura build (versionCode 137+).
